content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "no", "applies_why": "The judge does not weigh a pressing-side chain against a live link; it treats C4 as aimed at a limb the defender dropped, so there is no live chain-vs-chain collision for K-C to govern.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "none", "why": "The judge's reason is the dropped limb, not a verse-by-verse or stating-verse test, and no chain-vs-chain collision remains once the challenged limb is dropped."}
